sys_script_client.description: Terminal-state form lockdown for x_casemgmt_case (QA Issue 17). On load, when status is Closed, disables the ten writable fields (subject, type, status, priority, description, requester_name, requester_email, assigned_group, assigned_agent, pending_reason) through g_form.setDisabled, and additionally sets the DOM disabled property on Choice controls because the platform's client-side read-only treatment sets only the inert HTML readonly attribute on a select. Backs up ../ui_policy/x_casemgmt_case_closed_readonly.xml, whose description action has no runtime effect on this release: measured on CASE9000006, g_form.isDisabled('description') returned false and the textarea was editable while the other nine fields were protected, correlating with the platform's repeated "renderNACMFieldLevel is not defined" text-area exception in runBeforeRender. Does not touch a non-Closed form (early return) and does not remove the Update verb, because AAP Section 0.5.5 requires the blocking message "Closed cases are terminal and cannot be modified." to be surfaced on an attempt. Enforcement of the rule itself remains server-side in ../business_rules/x_casemgmt_block_terminal_closed.xml; this record governs only what the form presents. Per AAP Sections 0.4.4, 0.5.5 and 0.7.2.
sys_script_client.name: x_casemgmt_case_closed_readonly_enforce
